name: Password Panic
description:
The Starlight Arena surprise concert presale sold out in only 90 seconds.

Investigators believe a ticket-buying bot may have gained access to a staff account connected to the presale system.

## Your Mission

1. Download and examine `password_evidence.txt`.
2. Review the password reminder and staff profile information.
3. Use the clues to determine the weak password that could have been guessed.
4. Submit the recovered password using this format:

`GRIFFITH{password}`

Example:

`GRIFFITH{example123}`

hints.title: Hint 1: Password Reminder
hints.content: Look carefully at the password reminder recovered by investigators. What two pieces of information does it tell you to combine?

hints.title: Hint 2: Staff Profile
hints.content: Check the staff profile information in the evidence file. The password was created by combining the favourite band with the concert year.
